visual.name: bfusionResourceHeatmap
visual.description: A custom heatmap to visualize resource utilization.

dataRoles.name: hours
dataRoles.description: Bind with Capacity for exact totals: every roll-up, TEAM TOTAL and insight becomes hours ÷ capacity. Any unit, as long as Capacity uses the same one.

dataRoles.name: capacity
dataRoles.description: Capacity in the same unit as Scheduled Hours, spread over calendar days when the Period is a date.

dataRoles.name: licenseToken
dataRoles.description: Bind to the single-cell BFusionLicense[Key] column in your model

mode.description: Surface theme for the visual chrome. Auto follows the report theme's background.

background.description: Custom mode only. Plot and root background.

surface.description: Custom mode only. Header, toolbar, panels, tiles and tooltips.

textColor.description: Custom mode only. Primary text colour.

mutedColor.description: Custom mode only. Labels, captions and axis text.

ruleColor.description: Custom mode only. Separators, tile borders and axis lines.

showQuestions.description: Show the row of resourcing questions (Who is overloaded? Who has room for more work? Where can work move? ...). One click keeps the rows that answer it, dims the other cells and spells out the answer.

focusMode.description: Show only the rows that need a resourcing decision (overloaded, idle, under-used, hours without capacity) with the reason per row. Viewers switch it with the Focus button.

valueScale.description: How the bound Utilization % measure encodes a percentage.

licenseKey.description: Paste your BFusion license key here. Contact info@bfusion.eu for a license.
